Dive into the BRAND NEW nail-biting psychological thriller from Alex Stone

A tale of toxic love, obsession and revenge with a twist you won't see coming - for fans of Andrea Mara, Lisa Jewell and Claire Douglas

When Kirsty and Ryan broke up, Kirsty didn’t just lose the man she loved. She lost the life she’d built around him. The future they’d promised each other.

But now he’s left her for Charlotte. Again. The woman his family always preferred.

And Kirsty is done waiting. Done hoping. Done being the one left behind.

This time, she wants revenge.

Consumed by jealousy, Kirsty becomes obsessed by Charlotte, turning into a stalker as she digs into her life and uncovers secrets and lies buried deep within Ryan's family. Lies that involve her.

But the more Kirsty learns, the more dangerous her obsession becomes.

Because revenge was one thing.

But murder is something else entirely.

Praise for Alex Stone:

'Tense, thrilling and full of dark secrets that lead to a shocking showdown. Absolutely loved it!!!' Bestselling author Shalini Boland

'Clever, bold and original, The Quiet Sister had me gripped until I'd devoured every last page. Stone is a masterclass in thriller writing!' Bestselling author Awais Khan

'A twisted tale of twins and a tangled web of deception where nothing is quite as it seems; gripping!' Bestselling author Jackie Kabler
